title: In French Animated Satire ‘Jim Queen,’ a Queer Influencer Contracts a Virus That Turns Gay Men Heterosexual. Mon Dieu!
summary: Nicolas Athane and Marco Nguyen's feature directorial debut, premiering in style in Midnight Screenings, takes us inside Paris' queer scene, and face-to-face with the "Gaystapo," in a race against time to save the LGBTQIA+ community from extinction.
